extracted.intended_audience: policy-makers, program designers, agricultural/environmental researchers and practitioners designing or evaluating agri-environmental payment schemes (especially in Canada/Quebec)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluative criteria for designing, implementing and comparing payments for environmental services from agriculture (contracts, payment types, eligibility, administration, targeting, and example rates). Emphasis on program features drawn from international examples (UK, Scotland, France, Switzerland, Finland) and Canadian pilots (ALUS, GreenCover).

rubrics_metrics.name: Points-based scoring with threshold for eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Dédommagement uniforme auquel on se qualifie en entreprenant un nombre suffisant d’actions; le calcul s'effectue en additionnant les points de chaque action, le seuil visé étant généralement 30 points par hectare en moyenne pour toute la ferme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example (Entry Level Stewardship, UK): individual actions carry point values (e.g. entretien des haies 22 points/100 m; ensemencement à fleurs 450 points/ha; bandes tampon 400 points/ha; plan de fertilisation 2 points/ha; prairie à faible intrant 85 points/ha). Farmers receive payment if farm-average threshold reached.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixed per-action payments by unit/area
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribuer une valeur applicable à chaque action entreprise, calculée par unité ou par surface (paiement par action).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in Scotland and France: payments are annual rentes basées sur l’action entreprise et déterminées à l’avance (examples: France CAD: reconversion des terres 259.16 €/ha/an; entretien des haies 0.37 €/m/an; races menacées 46 €/UA/an). Payment units include €/ha, €/m, $/arbre, €/UA, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract duration and payment schedule (including amortization)
rubrics_metrics.description: Program contracts have explicit durations and payment timing (e.g., 5-year contracts with annual payments; 9-year ALUS contracts modifiable at 3 years; conservation contracts of 10–21 years). Capital purchases may be paid as forfaits répartis sur la durée du contrat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scotland: 5-year contract with annual payments that cover infrastructure and compliance; capital items (fences, trees, basins) paid as lump-sum amounts spread over 5 years. GreenCover: payments divided into conversion-cost portion and an ongoing incentive portion for 10-year conservation clauses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eco‑conditionality / baseline good practice requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Accès aux paiements conditionnel au respect d’une prestation écologique requise (niveau de bonnes pratiques de référence).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Switzerland and EU frameworks require farmers to meet a baseline ('prestation écologique requise') before qualifying for additional payments; ecological contributions target practices exceeding that baseline (e.g., prohibition on certain treatments or organic fertilizer spreading).

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorisation of payments (area, animal, ecological, ethological)
rubrics_metrics.description: Structurer paiements en catégories distinctes: contributions à la surface, contributions pour la garde d'animaux (fourrages grossiers; conditions difficiles), contributions écologiques (compensations écologiques, production extensive, agriculture biologique), contributions éthologiques (systèmes de stabulation respectueux, sorties régulières en plein air).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designers should define categories and eligible measures within each (examples from Switzerland: area payment as main contribution; ecological compensations for prairies extensives, jachères florales; ethological payments tied to husbandry practices such as minimum outdoor outings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment modulation by farm size and income thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Montants réduits graduellement à mesure que la taille de la ferme augmente; exclusions basées sur farm size or taxable income.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Swiss example: full table amounts accessible to farms <30 ha or <45 UA; farms of 90 ha or >135 UA not admissible; some aids inaccessible to farmers above a taxable income threshold. Use sliding scales or caps to favor small holdings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decentralized administration and local adaptation
rubrics_metrics.description: Administration décentralisée (cantons, départements) disposant d’une latitude pour modifier paramètres et définir contrats types locaux.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: France CAD: gestion au niveau des préfectures; each department determines a contract type. Switzerland: cantons present latitude in parameter modification. Decentralization allows regional priorities and coherence but requires coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional priority measures / targeting for coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification de mesures prioritaires à entreprendre dans tous les contrats pour assurer la cohérence des efforts régionaux.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: France (Mayenne): authorities identified three priority measures (e.g., winter cover crops) that all applicants must undertake. Programs may combine national measures (e.g., support to organic conversion) with region-specific priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-sharing of initial establishment costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Prévoir un partage des coûts initiaux d’application des pratiques entre programme et bénéficiaire (ou autres partenaires).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Norfolk ALUS pilot: specified cost‑sharing ratios for establishment (e.g., 66% ALUS/33% Ministry; 50–75% shares depending on practice). Manitoba pilot did not include measures for sharing initial costs. Explicit cost-share rules affect uptake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment for capital assets with amortization
rubrics_metrics.description: Paiements forfaitaires pour l’achat ou l’installation d’éléments d’actifs (clôtures, arbres, bassins), répartis sur la durée du contrat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scotland: payments for capital items are offered as forfaits (payable per linear metre, per stem, etc.) and distributed over the 5-year contract. Design should state unit prices and amortization schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progressive (additive) vs degressive (declining) payment trajectories
rubrics_metrics.description: Deux approches temporelles: progressive (augmenter le paiement à mesure que de nouvelles mesures sont ajoutées) ou dégressive (fortes compensations initiales diminuant au fil des années pour la conversion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finland: start with fixed €/ha and require additional measures in subsequent years to increase payment. Organic Aid Scheme Scotland: high initial compensation for conversion (e.g., £220 in year 1) declining over 5 years then a maintenance payment (£30) up to year 10.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment rate estimation methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Déterminer niveaux de paiement à partir de sources variées: valeur de location des terres environnantes, taxes municipales, estimations de coûts et bénéfices de l’industrie agricole, données provinciales de productivité, et valeur des dédommagements dans des ententes de conservation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ALUS pilot used local rent values, municipal tax levels, cost/benefit estimates, provincial productivity and conservation agreement values to set annual rents. Use transparent empirical basis for rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary participation with caps on eligible area
rubrics_metrics.description: Programmes volontaires limitant la superficie admissible par propriétaire (ex: plafonnement à 20% des terres d’un propriétaire).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ALUS principle: voluntary participation and cap eligible area at 20% per owner. Caps prevent excessive enrollment and control program budget/exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration with existing payment/administrative networks
rubrics_metrics.description: Intégrer le programme aux réseaux de paiements existants (ex: organismes gérant l’assurance-récolte) et coopérer avec partenaires locaux pour l’implantation et l’administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ALUS proposes local administration via organizations that already manage payments (MRAC equivalence). Integration lowers transaction costs and leverages existing infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting sensitive sites and flexibility in contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Cibler des sites sensibles pour maximiser environmental benefits; offrir contrats flexibles (modifiable aux intervalles définis, ex. every 3 years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ALUS: targeted on sensitive sites, flexible 9-year contract modifiable at 3 years. Targeting improves environmental returns per dollar spent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typology of admissible practices (annual, multi-annual, permanent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Classer pratiques admissibles en annuelles (gestion des pâturages, cultures annuelles), multi‑annuelles (conversion à couvert de conservation), et permanentes (gestion de zones riveraines, zones de faune, puits de carbone, zones humides).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ALUS provided explicit lists for each class. Program rules should enumerate eligible practices and any practice‑specific conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conservation agreements and servitudes as payment modalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Utiliser l’acquisition, les ententes de conservation ou servitudes pour limiter les droits de développement en échange d’une rétribution (ou d’aides techniques), avec clauses de long terme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Ducks Unlimited 'Hay Conservation Program' pays for permanent cover under 10- or 21-year contracts; some agreements provide physical works and advice rather than direct payments. Servitudes may also enable tax-credit treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Split-payment design: conversion costs vs ongoing incentive
rubrics_metrics.description: Séparer le versement en une portion couvrant les coûts initiaux de conversion et une portion servant d’incitatif à long terme pour le maintien (peut être ajustée si la première partie couvre plus que le coût réel).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GreenCover divides payment: part covers conversion (semences, establishment), remainder is an incentive tied to a 10-year maintenance clause and may be adjusted by authorities if the conversion payment exceeds establishment costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility transitions and targeting of previous program participants
rubrics_metrics.description: Limiter certaines actions ou avantages aux agriculteurs ayant participé à précédents programmes (transitional eligibility), ou restreindre nouvelles actions pour honorer engagements antérieurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: France CAD: many actions available exclusively to farmers who previously concluded a CTE; CAD limited the number of such carry‑over actions. Transitional rules can reward prior adopters but may reduce broad accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of payment unit (per ha, per metre, per stem, per UA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Choisir l’unité de rétribution la plus adaptée: €/ha, €/m linear (hedges/fences), €/arbre (per stem), €/UA (animal unit), or per‑practice lump sums.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples across programs: hedges paid per 100 m or per m; trees per stem; animal-related payments per UA. Unit choice affects equity and administrative simplicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic and terrain modulation (slope, viticulture, marginal lands)
rubrics_metrics.description: Moduler paiements selon caractéristiques géographiques/physiques (terrain en pente, parcelles viticoles en pente, marginal/steep land), encourage exploitation of difficult parcels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Swiss contributions include special payments for steep land and viticultural slopes; modulation encourages continued use of marginal parcels and conservation of landscape values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of animal welfare (ethological) measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclure contributions destinées à des systèmes d’élevage respectueux et aux sorties régulières en plein air des animaux (ex: minimum sorties par jour).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Switzerland lists 'contributions éthologiques' for housing systems respectful of animals and regular outdoor access (typically once per day). Design measurable husbandry conditions to qualify.
